chosen.title: patient arriving at dental office
chosen.faces: partial - woman in 3/4 profile looking down, dentist masked with face shield; no frontal face
chosen.why: Only downloaded candidate with an actual sitting-down motion. Woman in yellow shirt walks in from behind (5-8s), turns and lowers into the chair; her body stops descending at ~9.5s (contact), 9.6-10.5s she is settled. Chair is a dental chair in a clinic, not an office chair, and the angle is 3/4 side rather than pure back view. Natural white light, unsaturated, no text/logo. Reads as 'sits' in 0.7s; setting is clinic, which may suit a hospital promo but deviates from the brief.

alternates.why: Best-matching setting: back view of a man already seated in a black office chair at a desk, natural office light, no logos. No sit-down action anywhere in the 11s - static 'sitting' only, so it reads 'at desk' rather than 'sits down'.
Side/back view of a man seated at a desk, no sit-down action; heavy red/magenta lighting so tone is off even after desaturation. Fallback only.

notes: Mixkit title search returned no clip of a person sitting down into an office chair (6 sheets: 'sitting down office chair', 'man sits at desk', 'woman sits down chair', 'sitting down at desk', 'sits down', 'office chair'). Four candidates downloaded: 39840, 44072, 29993 (all already seated throughout, no sit motion; 29993 also has a laptop screen full of text) and 12141 (has a real sit-down at ~9.5s but in a dental clinic). Chose 12141 for the action with a low fit score; if the editor prefers setting over action, use 39840 from 0.0s. Consider re-searching with other wording ('takes a seat', 'arrives at office', 'starts work') if the office-chair back view is essential.
